closing.text: Free Wi-Fi access, complimentary breakfast for two each day, a priority upgrade when one is available at check-in, and a $100 property credit, or $200 for suites: that's what the WhataHotel preferred rate adds at this hotel. That preferred-rate offer can also be combined with the hotel's listed exclusive perks, subject to each offer's terms.
